title: Chai at 3:07
season_arc: Kabir learns why the stall chose him, and who Noor was before the road took her.

characters.name: Kabir
characters.personality: Gruff, practical, believes in nothing he cannot repair, quietly grieving
characters.voice: Deep, tired male voice, Hindi-accented English, speaks slowly
characters.visual_block: Kabir, a 45-year-old Indian truck driver with a thick grey-streaked beard, a deep crease between his brows, wearing a faded maroon turban, a brown wool shawl over a khaki shirt

episodes.title: Chai at 3:07, Ep 1: The Stall That Wasn't There
episodes.summary: A tea stall appears on a mountain highway at 3:07 every night. Everyone who stops there is about to die on the road, and tonight it's Kabir's turn.
episodes.cliffhanger: Kabir's own truck drives past the stall with Kabir at the wheel, heading for the broken bridge.
